Sofia K.: Quick heads-up — I ran the weekend runway sim for EU1 and APAC shadow traffic. p95 looks fine but p99 spikes if we keep current soft-cap at 6500 tokens/s per GPU.

Ken: Can you paste the sim numbers?

Sofia K.: Sure. Summary: baseline RPS + 45% holiday uplift, avg seq=320 tokens, 99th token throughput tail causes queue depth to hit ~220 requests -> p99 ~1.45s (target 1.1s).

Priya: Oof. What's the required GPU-hours to avoid that?

Sofia K.: Rough calc: required_gpus = ceil((RPS_effective * avg_seq) / (tokens_per_gpu_hour / 3600)). Using tokens_per_gpu_hour=1.8M (current q4 quant profile) -> roughly +18 GPUs for EU1 during peak 6h window (~108 GPU-hours).

Jamal: That matches my quick run. If we instead relax p99 to 1.25s we only need +8 GPUs. Tradeoff: higher p99 risk for tail-heavy customers.

Maria: Cost for +18 GPUs on Dedicated estimate?

Sofia K.: Ballpark: $3.8k/day for the 6h peak if reserved hourly pricing, or ~ $5.2k/day on burst on-demand.

Ken: Could we use targeted prewarm + KV-prefix cache to reduce effective tokens_per_request? Any sim?

Sofia K.: Yes — enabling prefix caching for the largest flows cuts avg_seq by ~22% in sim -> reduces extra GPUs to +10. Put the flags in config and test rollout:
``` 
service.configs.ServeOptions {
  prefix_cache: true
  cache_ttl_seconds: 1800
}
```

Priya: Also consider admission control knob: lower soft-admit threshold for background jobs by 30% during peak. That buys more tail headroom without full GPU add.

ops-bot: /run sim --profile=holiday_peak --cache=on --admit=soft30 -> Simulation finished: p95=0.67s p99=1.12s queue_peak=95

Jamal: Nice. ops-bot sim shows combined approach (cache + soft30) keeps p99 under 1.2s with only +6 GPUs.

Maria: Action items? I'm logging a short runbook: 1) Enable prefix_cache flag in eu1 canary (Priya), 2) Deploy admit soft30 routing policy for background tier (Ken), 3) Schedule +6 GPUs reservation for 6-12 UTC on Sat-Sun (Finance/Capacity) (Maria).

Ken: I can take #2, will push policy and monitor traces. Priya you take canary. Sofia — can you attach the sim csv and the small plotting script to the ticket?

Sofia K.: Will do. Attaching sim CSV and a tiny plotting snippet to the ticket now. Note: keep an eye on cross-region failover — if eu->apac shift happens, we need fast capacity rebalancing, not just add-on GPUs.

Maria: Good call. I'll add a contingency note: fallback to model-quantized variant (q3a) if we see >10% cross-region reroute.

Priya: Rolling canary after lunch. If all green, schedule policy change and reservation request by EOD. :rocket:

Ken: Thanks team. I'll watch the dashboards during the canary window. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
